definition: location · time of day · atmosphere · named practical light sources
why_this_scope: Changing where the film is set is not a shot note. It re-renders everything, and the parameter set is where the format already puts things that are constant for the whole work.

definition: focal length · aperture · depth of field · format and optical artifact
why_this_scope: A production shoots on a lens package. A per-shot lens is a continuity error with extra steps.

definition: named stock or process · palette · contrast
why_this_scope: The lab timing, and chain-wide by the same logic that made it chain-wide on film.

definition: an override of the SPS grade for a reel or sequence
why_this_scope: The codec already defines EPS as an SPS override for a span, so a re-graded reel is a small localised unit rather than a rewrite. A colour sequence is exactly that span.

definition: an override for a location change mid-work

dirties: this unit and its predicted chain
definition: who or what, and the one thing it does — the motion thesis
why_this_scope: A unit with no motion event is a wasted synthesis and an ambiguous hand-off: the frame it passes forward could have come from anywhere in the clip. One event, named, not three.

dirties: this unit and its predicted chain
definition: the single physical event the shot is about

dirties: this unit and its predicted chain
definition: shot size and shot type, in industry notation
why_this_scope: Size and type are per-shot by definition. Two adjacent units at the same size with the same move are one shot with a seam in it.

dirties: this unit and its predicted chain
definition: camera position relative to the subject

dirties: this unit and its predicted chain
definition: exactly one move from the closed set, with what it hands forward and what it accepts
why_this_scope: One move per unit. At the lengths a generation window allows, a second move has no time to read as a move — it reads as instability, and it poisons the frame the next unit is welded to.

dirties: this unit and its predicted chain
definition: source, then direction, then quality, for this framing
why_this_scope: Direction is per-framing even when the fixture is not. The same practical keys a wide and a close differently.

dirties: this unit onward in the chain
definition: tokens added or removed against the reference I-Node's prompt
why_this_scope: Never a fresh prompt. A P-Node carrying a whole prompt is an I-Node that has lied about its cost.

dirties: this unit onward in the chain
definition: the motion delta as a matrix, drawn from the closed move set
why_this_scope: The move vocabulary is the same one an I-Node uses; here it appears as a change rather than a state. Composition across a P-chain must satisfy hands-forward and accepts at every link.

dirties: this unit onward in the chain
definition: a pure advance in time with no other change
why_this_scope: The whole payload of a HOLD.

dirties: this unit onward in the chain
definition: pose, depth, edge or other conditioning signal deltas
A P-Node never carries a fresh seed.
why_this_scope: Stated in the codec. A seed is what makes a unit intra; a predicted unit that reseeds is unmoored from its anchor and the delta means nothing.
